investment_signals.headline: Spotify reached 300 million Premium subscribers in Q2 2026 while gross margin rose to 33.4%.
investment_signals.detail: Premium Subscribers grew 9% year over year to 300 million and MAUs rose 12% to 777 million. Total revenue was €4.8 billion, gross margin was 33.4%, operating income was €655 million, and free cash flow was €797 million.
investment_signals.metric_name: Premium subscribers / MAU / gross margin / operating income / free cash flow

investment_signals.headline: Spotify Premium ARPU increased to €4.89 in Q2 2026.
investment_signals.detail: The Q2 2026 shareholder deck reports Premium revenue of €4,331 million, up 15% year over year. Premium ARPU was €4.89, up 7% year over year (7.4% constant currency).

investment_signals.headline: Spotify slightly exceeded its Q2 2026 subscriber and gross-margin guidance.
investment_signals.detail: The shareholder deck shows actual Premium subscribers of 300 million versus 299 million guided, MAUs of 777 million versus 778 million guided, gross margin of 33.4% versus 33.1% guided, and operating income of €655 million versus €630 million guided. Revenue was €4.8 billion versus €4.8 billion guided.
investment_signals.metric_value: Premium 300M vs 299M; gross margin 33.4% vs 33.1%; operating income €655M vs €630M

investment_signals.headline: Spotify announced a $1 monthly Premium increase in the US and two Baltic markets.
investment_signals.detail: Spotify said subscribers in the US, Estonia and Latvia would receive an email about the update. Reuters reported the monthly price moving from $11.99 to $12.99, with February 2026 billing dates affected; Spotify said the additional revenue would be reinvested in the platform and creator support.

investment_signals.headline: Spotify announced price updates across multiple international regions.
investment_signals.detail: Spotify said subscribers in South Asia, the Middle East, Africa, Europe, Latin America and Asia-Pacific would receive emails explaining the change over the following month. Reuters reported the monthly individual price rising from €10.99 to €11.99 in markets including those regions, but the exact country-by-country effective date was not stated.

investment_signals.headline: Spotify said it had not seen a significant churn increase after broad price increases.
investment_signals.detail: Reuters reported CFO Christian Luiga said that despite price increases in more than 150 countries, Spotify had not observed any significant rise in customer churn. The source did not provide a numeric churn rate or a country breakdown.
investment_signals.metric_value: No significant rise reported; no numeric rate stated

investment_signals.headline: Spotify reported Q4 2025 revenue of €4.5 billion and 290 million Premium subscribers.
investment_signals.detail: The Q4 release said Premium subscribers reached 290 million and MAUs 751 million. Total revenue was €4.5 billion, gross margin 33.1%, operating income €701 million, and free cash flow €834 million.
investment_signals.metric_name: Premium subscribers / MAU / gross margin / operating income / free cash flow

investment_signals.headline: Spotify said the European Commission found Apple’s anti-competitive conduct unlawful and fined Apple over €1.8 billion.
investment_signals.detail: Spotify said EU iPhone users could see pricing information and that they could purchase on Spotify’s website after the Commission decision. Spotify also said it still could not freely offer a simple in-app purchase link because of Apple fees. This context predates the current 2024-09-27 to 2026-09-27 backfill window.

A June 2024 YouGov survey of 1,000 US adults reported 61% of paid users would continue their current subscription, 19% might cancel and 4% would definitely cancel after the price increase; these were stated intentions, not observed cancellations. YouTube Music was the most cited potential alternative at 39%, followed by Apple Music and Amazon Music at 32% each.

key_findings: Q2 2026 was a strong monetization/scale checkpoint: Spotify reported 300M Premium subscribers (+9% Y/Y), 777M MAUs (+12%), €4.8B revenue, 33.4% gross margin, €655M operating income and €797M FCF (https://newsroom.spotify.com/2026-08-04/spotify-q2-2026-earnings/).

Premium ARPU reached €4.89 in Q2 2026, up 7% Y/Y (7.4% constant currency), while Premium revenue rose 15% Y/Y to €4,331M (https://s29.q4cdn.com/175625835/files/doc_financials/2026/q2/Q2-2026-Shareholder-Deck-FINAL.pdf).

The latest fetched Spotify pricing announcement before this daily run was the 2026-01-15 US/Estonia/Latvia update; the US monthly price moved from $11.99 to $12.99 for February 2026 billing dates (https://newsroom.spotify.com/2026-01-15/premium-pricing-update/).

The August 2025 international move covered South Asia, the Middle East, Africa, Europe, Latin America and Asia-Pacific; Reuters reported the monthly individual price moving from €10.99 to €11.99, but the exact local-country schedule was not published (https://www.reuters.com/business/spotify-raise-premium-subscription-price-select-markets-september-2025-08-04/).

Current official Spotify pages show a wide regional price ladder: US Individual $12.99, Canada $13.99, Germany €12.99, Portugal €8.99, India Standard ₹139 and Korea Individual ₩11,990 (all retrieved 2026-09-27; localized URLs are in pricing_baseline).

Spotify’s current US Individual price is below the captured official YouTube Premium US Individual price of $15.99, but no derived cross-service comparison is reported because complete localized inputs and a dated FX conversion were not available for a clean comparison row (https://www.spotify.com/us/premium/; https://www.youtube.com/premium).

Visible US Google Play review text explicitly asks Spotify to lower prices rather than increase Premium by an extra dollar every year; the fetched listing showed 4.3 stars and 36.4M top-level reviews on 2026-09-27 (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.spotify.music&hl=en_US).
No sourced Apple Music, YouTube, Amazon Music, Deezer or Tidal price response to the Spotify 2025 or 2026 moves was found; competitor_reactions is therefore empty rather than inferred.
analyst_summary.hike_pattern: The sourced history shows two broad moves: an international announcement on 2025-08-04, reported by Reuters as €10.99 to €11.99 (+9.1%) effective sometime in September 2025, followed by a specifically disclosed US move announced 2026-01-15 from $11.99 to $12.99 (+8.3%) for February 2026 billing. The sources do not support a reliable country ordering, exact September 2025 billing date, or complete 24-month country-by-country cadence (https://newsroom.spotify.com/2025-08-04/upcoming-changes-to-spotify-premium-subscriptions/; https://www.reuters.com/business/spotify-raise-premium-subscription-price-1299-month-select-markets-2026-01-15/).
bull_points: Scale and profitability improved together in Q2 2026: 300M Premium subscribers, 33.4% gross margin, €655M operating income and €797M FCF (https://newsroom.spotify.com/2026-08-04/spotify-q2-2026-earnings/).

Premium ARPU increased 7% Y/Y to €4.89, supporting the pricing-power thesis while Premium revenue grew 15% Y/Y (https://s29.q4cdn.com/175625835/files/doc_financials/2026/q2/Q2-2026-Shareholder-Deck-FINAL.pdf).

Management’s cited churn commentary was that no significant churn increase was observed despite price increases in more than 150 countries, although no numeric churn rate was disclosed (https://www.reuters.com/business/spotify-raise-premium-subscription-price-1299-month-select-markets-2026-01-15/).
bear_points: The US Google Play review sample contains direct price backlash, including a complaint about an extra dollar increase every year and ads (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.spotify.music&hl=en_US).

The 2024 YouGov survey found 19% of paid US users said they might cancel and 4% definitely would after the price increase; this is stated intention, not realized churn (https://yougov.com/en-us/articles/50070-expectations-for-spotifys-second-price-increase-in-two-years).

Pricing evidence is incomplete across seven Spotify countries and nearly all YouTube localized markets, limiting country-level ARPU and competitor-premium conclusions (localized URLs and gaps are recorded above).
watch_items_next_5_days: Recheck Spotify newsroom and Investor Relations daily for any pricing announcement, plan/tier change or Q3 2026 guidance update: https://newsroom.spotify.com/ and https://investors.spotify.com/.
Re-fetch each missing Spotify localized Premium page for AR, CO, CL, PE, JP, EG and SA and inspect plan cards for Basic/Lite/audiobook-inclusive tiers.

Track US/GB/AU App Store and Google Play ratings, review counts and newly visible price-related reviews; record review dates if the store exposes them.
Check Spotify’s next earnings/IR publication page for Premium ARPU, gross margin, operating income, FCF, churn commentary and forward guidance; do not carry forward Q2 values.

run_schedule.weekly_production_schedule: Daily run at 13:00 UTC; weekly production roll-up after the Friday 2026-09-30 run.

implementation_notes: Fetch official localized pages first and retain the exact rendered URL; reject generic US-dollar output when the requested country is not the US.
Capture recurring price separately from trial or introductory price; never place a trial amount in price.
Use official filings/IR for operating metrics and reputable press only when the official source does not provide the event detail; record publication and retrieval dates.
Detect and diff tier names, prices, currency, tax wording and offers against the prior daily snapshot; flag NEW only when a page or source dated after 2026-09-25 changes.

For FX, use a dated official central-bank rate and only compute derived_metrics when Spotify, Apple Music and YouTube Premium localized individual prices are all explicit for the same country and period.
Store failed pages and missing tiers as explicit gaps; do not estimate, average, or carry forward missing prices.
App-store review sentiment must preserve the store’s rating/count and quote only visible price-related review text; do not infer cancellation from sentiment.

message: Daily snapshot completed for 2026-09-27 with Spotify-first localized pricing, sourced operating signals, price history, consumer observations, and explicit gaps. Derived metrics were intentionally omitted because no country had a fully clean localized Spotify + Apple Music + YouTube Premium individual price set without relying on a generic placeholder.
